faq.title: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions

q1.question: How do I play music?
q1.answer: Use `/play <song name or URL>` to play music. The bot will join your voice channel and start playing.

q2.question: Why is the music laggy or cutting out?
q2.answer: This is usually due to network issues. Try using `/resetbitrate` or check your server region.

q3.question: How do I create a playlist?
q3.answer: Use `/collections create <name>` to create a collection. Then use `/collections save <name>` to save the current queue.

q4.question: What music sources are supported?
q4.answer: YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, and direct URLs are supported.

q5.question: How do I skip a song?
q5.answer: Use `/skip` to skip the current track, or `/skipto <number>` to jump to a specific track.

q6.question: How do I enable 24/7 mode?
q6.answer: 24/7 mode is a premium feature. Use `/premium` for more information.

faq.footer: Need more help? Join our support server with /support
